title: Chapter 256
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

"An ambush! How? " Tang Tang was shocked. "Sh * t, could it be that the Germinal Organization discovered us long ago and did not make a move because they wanted to numb us and wait for this opportunity to kill us all?"

"What's the use of hindsight?" Dina said angrily.

After the rescue team infiltrated the Germinal Organization's territory, they had not been attacked. They thought that their whereabouts had not been discovered, but they did not expect this to be a trap!

The situation suddenly took a turn for the worse!

More than ten hours ago, the leader secretly transferred some of the troops from the west, north, and south of the encirclement to this desert in advance to lie in ambush. If Han Xiao successfully broke through the encirclement from the east of the new stone wasteland, he would lie in ambush on the only way.

Han Xiao did not get any information about this operation from the forum because there were no players in the troops. The leader remembered Cyberlos' guess. If Zero was an Inhuman, perhaps there was a special communication method between the Inhumans. In order to be safe, the leader did not use any Mutants this time, and by a stroke of luck, they managed to hide the operation.

The temporary command center of the leader was not the headquarters but here!

They had been waiting for a long time!

On the sand dune in front of them, the leader stood with his hands behind his back. His long windbreaker danced with the sand, and his expression was hidden under the mask as usual. Behind him, dozens of executive officers lined up in a row, like hunters waiting for their prey to fall into a trap.

Their eyes locked onto each other from afar. They finally met!

The leader's cold voice sounded again from the communicator.

"Didn't you want to fight me? I'm right here. Do you dare to come?"

Han Xiao sighed. "Well done …"

The leader's move was both unexpected and reasonable. During the call with the leader last night, he was not the only one testing the leader; the leader was also testing him. Both of them had their own agendas.

As the role of the prey, it was very difficult to make a flawless plan in the enemy's home ground. It was impossible to completely control the enemy's reaction. What Han Xiao was facing was almost an all-encompassing net, and his conditions were limited. It was already very difficult for him to achieve this step.

After tricking the leader so many times, he had finally gotten back at him!

If it were not for the fact that he was the victim, Han Xiao would have applauded and whistled for the leader.

How difficult was that? It was too touching!

There was no such thing as a foolproof plan. There would always be unexpected situations, situations where one could not escape and could only be reckless. Strength was the only thing one could rely on. The goal of Han Xiao's plan was to obtain power. He was now standing at the upper limit of Version 1.0 and was only one step away from breaking through to Level 60.

The current situation was both dangerous and an opportunity.

About ten Grade C Supers versus thousands of well-equipped soldiers plus fifty Executive Officers!

"Isn't it just a head-on clash? Come on."

Han Xiao's expression was calm as he turned off the communicator. There was still a few dozen seconds of buffer time before the battle started. He checked his own status.

"Viper Modified has 61% Durability remaining, roughly 4,200 Armor Points, and over 3,800 HP remaining, roughly 87%. Above average condition."

In the mission tab, the additional calculation for the battle just now had also been received. [The Ultimate Trial] had reached 815/2000 progress.

"The enemy has a lot of people, and their firepower is fierce. Our advantage is that our individual combat power is strong, and we can suppress the enemy in terms of high-end combat power." Han Xiao calculated in his mind, and hoped that his teammates who had not yet appeared would be more helpful.

A new mission suddenly appeared on the interface.

You have triggered a Grade C Special Mission, [The Traitor's Counterattack]!

Mission Requirements: Defeat the leader of the Germinal Organization with a damage output of no less than 60%.

Mission Reward: Draw two skills or talents from the leader.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. "Damage output of no less than 60%? That's a little difficult."

Han Xiaoxin calculated. He had not fought the leader yet, so he had not seen his attributes. However, the leader was also a main character in the Blue Star storyline like Bennett, so he would definitely be extraordinarily strong. With his current condition, it would be difficult for him to even take out a third of the leader's health if he did not go all out, let alone defeat the leader.

There was interference everywhere on the battlefield, so there might not be a chance for him to fight the leader alone. However, although the difficulty of the mission was high, the reward made Han Xiao envious.

He could draw two skills or talents from the leader. As one of the main characters of the planet, the leader would definitely have a Molding Skill or Molding Ability. He might even have the legendary Super Luck Halo. However, he then recalled the tragedy of the Germinal Organization and said with uncertainty, "Hmm … he should have the Luck Halo."

At this time, the three vehicles accelerated at the same time and rushed toward the enemy.

Tang Tang said in a deep voice, "Everyone, prepare for battle!"

…

"This is a chance to wipe out the high-end combat power of Zero and the Six Nations in one fell swoop."

On the sand dune, the leader looked down at the three heavy armored off-road vehicles approaching.

He only had a dozen hours to mobilize the troops, and heavy vehicles like tanks would not be able to move over. The main force of the ambush was thousands of soldiers and temporary positions, forming a cover fire. Then, there were more than a dozen armed helicopters, and finally, the leader himself and dozens of executives as high-end combat power.

"Open fire!"

In an instant, the sound of guns and cannons rang out like thunder. A black rain of bullets came from all directions, filling up every inch of space. The support troops in the center were like trapped beasts. At this time, an oval purple translucent energy shield opened and enveloped the three vehicles. The overwhelming barrage of bullets exploded on the energy shield one after another. The energy shield flickered continuously as if it would disappear at any time, but the three vehicles were not damaged at all.

The high-speed movement scattered the thick smoke of the explosions, leaving behind a trail of black smoke. There was a minefield buried under the desert, causing yellow sand to fill the sky. The light of the energy barrier became even dimmer.

The source of the energy shield was the vehicle on the left rear. It was the Esper ability of an unknown teammate. Under the protection of the energy shield, they approached the Germinal Organization troops safely.

"Ordina, [Protector of the Purple Light] Farzhord." The leader's tone was calm. He had an impression of all the famous elites of the Six Nations, and he could guess who they were at a glance. The identity of the possible opponents were all under his control.

The support troops were about to rush into the position, but the leader did not panic at all. He adjusted the formation of the troops to avoid the frontal assault and used the tactic of attrition. He knew that ordinary troops would not be able to stop a group of powerful superhumans from approaching, so he was prepared.

The support troops rushed into the position as if they were in a quagmire. The leader's eyes flashed. "Let me see, who else?"
